title: Static overlay regions payload
description: Payload of video_re_detect_static_overlay_regions inside the detection envelope: regions whose edges stay put while the picture moves (logos, watermarks, frames, UI). Detection only: consumers must never use it to remove, mask or inpaint a logo or watermark. Pixel values refer to the analysed frame (envelope params analysis_width/analysis_height); bbox_ratio is resolution independent.

bbox.description: x, y, w, h in analysed-frame pixels

ratio_box.description: x, y, w, h divided by frame width/height

handling.description: Fixed policy marker: the regions are reported, never removed.

kind.description: opaque: the region's own pixels do not change; translucent: moving content shows through (alpha-blended watermark)

opacity_estimate.description: 1 - (low-quantile temporal std inside / median std of moving pixels); 1.0 for opaque

mean_color.description: median colour of the region box over the window (box includes some background)

edge_coherence.description: mean |time-averaged gradient| / mean |gradient| over the region's structure pixels

windows_skipped_static.description: windows where too little of the picture moved to separate overlays from content
